ground_truth_protocol.description: BACnet/IP (UDP 47808): BVLC header, NPDU (version, control and optional network addresses) and APDU; the APDU type and service choice select the message type. Tag-encoded service parameters have no fixed offsets and are one bytes field. Derived from the Wireshark/tshark dissection of the benchmark capture (dol/truth-file-derivation/scripts/build_truth.py): fields at a fixed offset in at least 60% of a type's messages, bitfields sharing a byte merged, arrays of 3+ equal fields and variable-position content kept as one bytes field (the modbus.json convention for register arrays); types with fewer than 5 messages are omitted.
ground_truth_protocol.offset_convention: BVLC fields use wire-absolute offsets 0..3; the other types are relative to the NPDU (offset 0 = NPDU version = wire offset 4).
